news.headline: California Privacy Agency Fines FedEx Nearly $3M
news.summary: California has fined FedEx nearly $3 million over alleged privacy violations - including failing to honor opt-out commands sent through the Global Privacy Control.

news.headline: Why the Data Center Backlash Could Fall Flat: Increased Costs “a Trade That These Hyperscalers Are Still Going to Want to Make”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysTexas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa plans to make newly permitted data centers pay taxes, avoid raising consumer power prices and use union labor. Gene Munster puts soft costs at about 15% of a data center’s bill, so a 30% jump in them raises the total only about 5%.
